This is the New Saint Croix Union. Wednesday's biography is Kevin Zabel, Mayor of Oakdale.

Kevin Zabel holds a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of St. Thomas and a master's degree in political management from George Washington University. He works for the Minnesota Realtors Association, handling marketing and communications efforts for realtors and homeowners across the state.

Before the council, he served on Oakdale's Planning Commission and chaired it. He was elected to the Oakdale City Council in 2016 and re-elected in 2020.

In a July 2026 post he wrote that it had been his honor to serve the community for the past ten years, as a city council member for six and mayor these past four years.

He has said his grandfather always taught him that society works best when people get off the sidelines and participate. He thinks that is especially true for the young people in the community who want to make Oakdale the place they raise a family. That is why he is running, to do his part to make Oakdale a great place to live and work, now and in the future.

In March 2026 council minutes he noted that as part of his day job he participated in Disability Services Day at the Capitol to advocate for people with disabilities, many of whom are on the autism spectrum.
